stem: A well child with normal electrolytes is fasting before surgery and needs maintenance intravenous fluids. Which fluid is most appropriate?

options.text: 0.9% sodium chloride with 5% glucose and potassium chloride when passing urine

explanation: Children needing maintenance IV fluids usually require isotonic fluid with glucose, with potassium added once renal function and urine output are adequate. Hypotonic fluids increase hyponatraemia risk.
